records.title: L2M: Mutual Information Scaling Law for Long-Context Language Modeling
records.reason: L2M develops a theoretical mutual-information scaling law and lower bound for history-state size; it motivates efficient architecture design but does not present a concrete inference implementation or measured serving gain.

records.title: Multi-LLM Collaborative Search for Complex Problem Solving
records.reason: MoSA combines multiple LLM search agents to improve complex reasoning accuracy; the abstract reports quality comparisons rather than inference-efficiency outcomes.

records.title: Independence Tests for Language Models
records.reason: The paper develops statistical tests for whether language models were trained independently and for identifying shared components; its goal is model analysis, not inference optimization.

records.title: LowRA: Accurate and Efficient LoRA Fine-Tuning of LLMs under 2 Bits
records.reason: LowRA quantizes LoRA adapters to reduce fine-tuning memory and improve training scalability; its measurements concern fine-tuning rather than inference.

records.title: Meta-Cultural Competence: Climbing the Right Hill of Cultural Awareness
records.reason: This position paper discusses cultural competence and evaluation in LLM systems; it does not present an inference/serving efficiency method.
